# Ticket 02

## Title

Autopopulate Unit Type and Unit Size

## Description

In the "CONDENSER TYPE" section:
- When a user selects the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant from their dropdowns, we should populate the Unit Type dropdown filtered by the condenser type and the refrigerant that was selected.
- After a user selects a Unit Type, we should populate the Unit Size dropdown filtered by the Refrigerant + Unit Type that was selected

## Acceptance Criteria

When we select the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant we should see the Unit Type dropdown filtered by Condenser Type + Refrigerant selected.
When we select the Unit Type, we should see the Unit Size dropdown filtered by Refrigerant + Unit Type selected.

## Relevant Discussion
The Refrigerants comes from an unitdesign api GET /dropdowns
the attribute to get Unit Type is SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant
for example, we sould filter by the "parent" that contains the refrigerant selected.
  "SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "display": "CU",
      "value": "CU",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "display": "CUE",
      "value": "CUE",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "R-513A"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },..
]

The attribute for Unit Size is SDCommonUnitModelSizes
for example, we sould filter by the "parent" that contains both the refrigerant and the Unit Type selected.
	
"SDCommonUnitModelSizes": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "display": "101",
      "value": "101",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "CU"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },
    {
      "id": 1,
      "display": "103",
      "value": "103",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "CU"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },...
]

previousInterpretation.requirementSummary: When a user selects a Condenser Type and Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown should be populated with options filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected, the Unit Size dropdown should be populated with options filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: If a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the system must populate the Unit Type dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant whose parent array contains the selected Refrigerant (and, as stated, the selected Condenser Type).

If a user selects a Unit Type, the system must populate the Unit Size dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitModelSizes whose parent array contains both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
The dropdown data is retrieved via a GET request to /dropdowns on the unitdesign API.
Only entries where isActive is true should be considered for filtering.
developerConsiderations: Call the unitdesign API GET /dropdowns to obtain SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant and SDCommonUnitModelSizes data.
Filter Unit Type options by checking each entry's parent array for inclusion of the selected Refrigerant (and Condenser Type if applicable).
Filter Unit Size options by checking each entry's parent array for inclusion of both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
Exclude any entries where isActive is false from the filtered results.
Update the Unit Type and Unit Size dropdowns dynamically in the UI when the relevant selections change.
ambiguities: How the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants.
Whether the Condenser Type appears in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or requires a separate mapping.
What should be displayed or how the UI should behave when no entries match the filter criteria.
Whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown.
If the Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type.
The exact structure, pagination, and error handling of the /dropdowns API response is not defined.
